fixits.message: re-pin the pick to the constraints as they are now

message: the instance pick for `/r1` was made for constraints that have changed since (recorded sha256:5b6c6ec7dc4d7bc91d4b9fd1bbe304fcabdc86b583d83fe0e11f481e9aaaaf5b, now sha256:3f7e01f72b40756cf3bdc7a1902fb2760627e222da02c4bcf7cec54adca24b94); a pick is re-made explicitly, never silently (D1). The fix-it re-pins it to the constraints as they are now.
